items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: we were doing a tribute to Charlie Parker, which — with Billy Eckstine and Jay McShann and Earl Hines, you know they had their bands together.

ctx.x: Now it needs a release. And — lovely.

Thank you. You know what? That happens to be my favorite composition. And I got only one bad break on it. Stan Getz wanted to record it. And Stan said, “Give me the music, I’ll record it.” So I gave him the music and then two months later he passed away. But I would have loved to have him record it because he had all those records with Chick Corea and this tune was — it was the both of them together. And that’s what — I would have loved to have him do that. And it’s been recorded by Al Haig and I think Steve Kuhn…
How do you write out your tunes if you want to publish them? And how much of them gets written out? Because I know sometimes guitars uses tablature, but if you wanted to write a lead sheet —
